messages.subject: Install inla
parts:
Dear team,

I'm interested in installing INLA in binary format for Linux. I have followed these steps:

module load R/4.2.0-foss-2020b

R

install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep=TRUE)

library(INLA)

options(timeout=300)

inla.binary.install()

library(INLA)
